Original notices, third-party licenses, and native PhET credits remain inside the HTML.
The measurement toolbar also displays attribution at the point of use.

The same-origin, pinned build allows length-tool.js to read the horizontal ruler's
model length (centimetres), its rendered rectangle width, and its global transform.
This includes native zoom and screen layout scaling. No reference length is guessed
from viewport dimensions and students do not need to calibrate. If the simulation is
unavailable or its ruler API cannot be read, measurement gives a loading message
instead of returning an unverified length.

When upgrading the simulation, verify ruler geometry, native zoom, both screens,
window resizing, and the browser's displayed ruler before updating the pinned hash.
